programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Bat Family; Pups Save a Mud Monster
programs.desc: The PAW Patrol works to free a bat family after a rock slide traps them inside their cave; snowboarders on Jake's Mountain become stuck on a broken chairlift while a monster is on the loose.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Aqua Pups Save the Reef; Aqua Pups Stop a Giant Squid
programs.desc: The Aqua Pups rescue Coral, Moby and McSquidly from a submarine before it crashes into a delicate reef; the Aqua Pups must save the Merpups' golden orb release when Moby lures a Giant Squid into Puplantis.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a High Flying Hen; Pups Save a Sloth
programs.desc: After Chickaletta accidentally takes flight on a toy airplane, it's up to the team to rescue her; Mayor Humdinger mistakes a sloth for a monkey, racing to find it and cover up his blunder.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Mountain Surfers; Pups Save Humdinger's Home Away From Home
programs.desc: A mighty wind sweeps Zuma and Harrigan off the beach and blows them all the way up to Jake's Mountain; Humdinger's driving lands him and his trailer at the top of a tall spire.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.sub_title: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies; The Tree House; The Playgroup; Treasure Hunt; The New Car
programs.desc: Peppa and George play in Grandpa Pig's garden; Grandpa Pig has a surprise; George joins Peppa's play group; Granny and Grandpa Pig organize a treasure hunt; Peppa's family goes for a drive.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Rescue Wheels: Pups vs. The Monster Mayor
programs.desc: Humdinger and Boomer team up to get Roxy out of the way so that they can put on the monster truck show and Humdinger can show off for his mom.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Goldfish; Pups Save a Flying Florist
programs.desc: Uncle Otis accidentally slips and tosses Julia and Julius's new goldfish, Marigold, into the river! When Ms. Marjorie and Mr. Park don wingsuits to see a rare flower, a flying squirrel sends them off course!

programs.title: Mr. Crocodile
programs.desc: When Mr. Crocodile loses a tooth, Daisy wants to make sure he gets a visit from the tooth fairy; Daisy and Mr. Crocodile's simple treehouse gets complicated when they try to add space for all their friends.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Stage Actor; Pups Save Fogstock
programs.desc: Francois kicks off his production, but he is accidentally transported into the woods and comes face-to-face with mountain lions that threaten his show; Mayor Humdinger's music festival shakes up Adventure Bay and causes a mess.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save Captain Crinkle-Cut/Pups Save the Big Nightlight
programs.desc: A french fry mascot needs help after being carried away by a flock of hungry seagulls; Mayor Humdinger tries to steal the Adventure Bay lighthouse.

programs.title: Rubble & Crew
programs.sub_title: The Crew Builds a Mini Golf Course; The Crew Builds a Butterfly Garden
programs.desc: When a family of bunnies hops onto the soccer field, Rubble and Crew use their construction skills to build a new sport, Bunny Ball; after the pups discover a new kind of butterfly, it flutters away.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups and Katie Stop the Barking Kitty Crew; Pups Save the Glasses
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger disrupts Adventure Bay with his barking kitties; Katie and the pups rescue the town; Cap'n Turbot loses his glasses.
